pictures.name: QT1-Spices-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Very early morning before sunrise, a dark blue sky just turning pink at the edge. Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with dark hair under a deep blue head covering and a plain earth-brown dress, with two other women, an older woman in a grey shawl and a younger woman in a rose-colored head covering, walk along a garden path among olive trees outside Jerusalem carrying small clay jars of spices and a little oil lamp, their faces worried and grieving, talking quietly. Hushed, tender.

pictures.name: QT5-Mary-Turns
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. In the garden at sunrise. Mary Magdalene, a woman in her thirties with dark hair under a deep blue head covering and a plain earth-brown dress, has turned around, her tear-streaked face suddenly lit with recognition and joy, one hand reaching out. In the foreground, Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, seen from behind over his shoulder, golden sunrise light all around him. The moment of being known by name.

pictures.name: QT6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern bedroom at dawn. A young woman sits on the edge of her bed with a small notebook, writing one line, pale morning light through the curtains on the page and on her face, a calm half-smile. Worry put down, hope.
